posts.name: Pradheepa
posts.cooked: Hi, we do four subjects in a term. Its not possible to remember all the dates , Assignment is completed in 1 day. Do they assess the skill of the student or just disable and reduce marks based on Date ? I didnt get enough reminder for BPT1 , I just got one email, there is a fair chance to miss an email . kindly consider the effort of the student .

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Hi Pradheepa, I can understand your frustration, however, there are enough checks in place to prevent such issues. The deadlines are clearly mentioned in the grading doc that each student is supposed to read at term starting for their courses. Further this is now added to course portal as well. Course portal announcement was also sent, once about the dates in general, and once for BPT1. Further, each course has its own calendar, you are supposed to add them to your google calendar and follow it, the deadline was mentioned there too. Further, if you read the new addition about modes of communication in the grading document end, it is clearly mentioned a standardized process of which notifications are sent where. Being an undergraduate student you are more than expected to be able to manage your schedules and deadlines. Taking four courses is a student choice, unlike other institutions. We encourage students to take four courses only if they are absolutely certain they can manage the course load. If you miss something despite these, the onus is on you.

The tests are to test your understanding yes, but also your attention to detail and basic sense of deadlines, which sadly models the real world perfectly, (which an UG degree is designed to make you ready for), if you are unable to keep up with deadlines you do not get continuances out of sympathy.

Do remember that this is an online degree, and it would miss certain aspects of an offline degree such as professors and peers casually mentioning and re-reminding you of your deadlines.

It is best to do the next BPTs properly and on time.
